allow_external_fetch.description: Allow trusted OMI backend to call configured external market APIs and update local evidence cache.

allow_llm.description: Must be true for analysis/report mode and requires server-side trust.

allow_write.description: Required only for persisted report mode.

analysis_horizon.description: Analysis horizon. auto defaults to swing, meaning medium-short-term evidence.

caller_profile.description: Caller label only. Server-side policy decides trust.

continuation.description: Optional prior fill plan id and selected action ids. Backend revalidates each action.

contract_version.description: The only public OMI decision contract. It provides bounded capability selection, data manifest, fill plan, and response budget.

conversation_context.description: Optional caller context such as prior OMI resolution.

intents.description: Optional multi-intent request. Target remains independent from analysis, freshness, quote, or risk intents.

market_data_params.description: Optional bounded market-data parameters for readers, for example provider, providers, symbols, symbol, instrument_type, interval, timeframe, bars, include_intraday, payload_level, intraday_limit, session_scope, trade_date, observations, holding_limit, health_limit, radar_limit, market, resource, target, or limit.

interval.description: Compatibility alias for intraday_interval. Prefer intraday_interval for new callers.

intraday_interval.description: Requested intraday bar interval. Responses expose requested_interval, source_interval, and effective_interval.

option_contract_month.description: Optional TXO month/week bucket such as 202608 or 202607W4.

option_strike_limit.description: Maximum number of strikes projected around the selected TXO expiry.

trade_date.description: Target-market trade date. US dates use America/New_York exchange dates.

output.description: Data purpose, independent of consumer identity or presentation.

payload_level.description: Evidence density, independent of answer mode.

position_context.description: Optional caller-supplied position context. OMI backend still owns decision semantics.

refresh_policy.description: Controls whether OMI should refresh stale local evidence before answering.

selection.description: OMI v4 bounded data selection. Choose registered capabilities and optional field/row limits; backend keeps provider, freshness, and fill policy ownership.

fields.description: Capability-keyed field lists. Backend rejects fields outside each capability's allowlist.

limits.description: Capability-keyed row/point limits. Also accepts intraday.points, daily.points, and history.points.

parameters.description: Capability-keyed typed query parameters. Only capabilities with a registered parameter schema accept entries here.

x-omi-capabilities.description: Taiwan five-level order book with provider event time, latency, spread, and top-five imbalance. Last-trade availability is not required for this component to be current.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan quote order book

x-omi-capabilities.description: Taiwan pre-open, closing, or disposition batch-auction state. An auction book can be current while the last trade is unavailable.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan quote auction state

x-omi-capabilities.description: Completed Taiwan cash-equity session close confirmed from current-session exchange evidence before official daily EOD publication. It never implies official-daily finalization.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan completed session close

x-omi-capabilities.description: Confirmed Taiwan stock or index close with explicit availability, source, display precision, and completed-session date semantics.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan official close

x-omi-capabilities.description: Provider-neutral technical structure with explicit data usability, price basis, lineage, and market-specific profile.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Technical structure snapshot

x-omi-capabilities.description: Versioned provider-neutral indicators with methods, warm-up, price basis, lineage, and data-usability disclosure.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Technical indicator snapshot
Taiwan stock relative strength versus TAIEX

x-omi-capabilities.description: Bounded SEC Form 4 transaction-ledger evidence with transaction-code, amendment, derivative, source, and freshness semantics.
x-omi-capabilities.title: SEC insider transactions

x-omi-capabilities.description: Reviewed relation-backed signals and lineage for a Taiwan stock. This is evidence context and does not imply causality.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Cross-market target relations

x-omi-capabilities.description: Ratio- and FX-adjusted direct ADR parity for an eligible Taiwan stock.
x-omi-capabilities.title: ADR parity

x-omi-capabilities.description: Bounded, source-attributed Open Intel Atlas context. It is supplemental shadow evidence and never changes OMI market facts or decision scores.
x-omi-capabilities.title: External news and event evidence

x-omi-capabilities.description: Canonical TAIEX and TPEx index snapshots from the shared Taiwan market-index summary reader.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan market indices

x-omi-capabilities.description: Upcoming official Taiwan stock events from the bounded local corporate-event cache. A current empty result is distinct from a missing event cache.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan stock upcoming events

x-omi-capabilities.description: Bounded Taiwan market corporate-event calendar over the existing official cache. The market target replaces a redundant calendar target while retaining explicit date, market, event-type, stock, pagination, and freshness semantics.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan corporate-event calendar

x-omi-capabilities.description: Official Taiwan stock event history from the bounded archive cache with explicit coverage and cache freshness.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan stock event history

x-omi-capabilities.description: Official Taiwan disposition status with effective dates, measure details, cache provenance, and explicit missing semantics.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan stock disposition status

x-omi-capabilities.description: Backend-derived Taiwan trading mode and restrictions. Unknown disposition cache state never defaults to unrestricted trading.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan stock trading restrictions

x-omi-capabilities.description: Taiwan sector performance with explicit ranking basis and coverage. The v1 fallback is labeled as an OMI local stock-sample aggregate, not an official full-market sector-index ranking.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan sector performance

x-omi-capabilities.description: Positive and negative stock contribution leaders for selected Taiwan indices. The estimated market-cap-weight method and source are always returned.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan index contribution leaders

x-omi-capabilities.description: Official TWSE/TPEx institutional net-flow values in TWD. Combined totals are withheld when component market dates do not match.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan market institutional flow

x-omi-capabilities.description: Official TWSE/TPEx margin-balance and short-balance changes with field-level TWD/share units and release status.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan market margin and short flow

x-omi-capabilities.description: Ranking over the bounded Taiwan daily sample available in the local OMI context. It is not a full-market screener.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan local sample ranking

x-omi-capabilities.description: Taiwan market-level institutional and margin context from completed official datasets.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan market chips

x-omi-capabilities.description: Deterministic ranking over the cached active TWSE/TPEx ordinary-stock universe. Reads only local normalized data and never triggers an implicit full-market refresh.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan stock screening ranking

x-omi-capabilities.description: Coverage and provenance for the screening snapshot returned by screening.ranking, including universe, window, and cache policy.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan stock screening coverage

x-omi-capabilities.description: Deterministic ranking over scheduler-owned Taiwan rolling intraday stock state. The read path is cache-only and never fans out to per-stock providers.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan intraday stock screening

x-omi-capabilities.description: Intraday industry and user-curated watchlist group metrics with explicit membership provenance; group membership is never inferred by the answer model.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan intraday hot groups

x-omi-capabilities.description: Taiwan same-time cumulative market trade-value state and historical pace baselines.
x-omi-capabilities.title: Taiwan market volume state

x-omi-targets.description: Let the OMI backend resolve one explicit target from the request.
x-omi-targets.title: Automatic target resolution

x-omi-targets.description: One market-level context. Taiwan uses market=TW.
x-omi-targets.title: Market

x-omi-targets.description: Dataset freshness and expected-date diagnostics for one market or all markets.
x-omi-targets.title: Data freshness

x-omi-targets.description: One Taiwan listed or OTC security.
x-omi-targets.title: Taiwan security

x-omi-targets.description: One United States listed security or supported index symbol.
x-omi-targets.title: United States security

x-omi-targets.description: One supported commodity, rate, or FX resource.
x-omi-targets.title: Resource asset

x-omi-targets.description: The trusted caller's saved OMI portfolio.
x-omi-targets.title: Portfolio

x-omi-targets.description: One supported United States macroeconomic series.
x-omi-targets.title: United States macro series

x-omi-targets.description: Public capability registry and readiness diagnostics.
x-omi-targets.title: Capability status
